hooks.text: 两百余技能叠加元素反应与技能共鸣，形成高自由度割草构筑
hooks.excerpt: There are more than 200 skills to choose from, and there are also elemental reactions and skill resonances, allowing you to beat the six-eared macaque in a fancy way!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 割草生存与种田建造并列成双模式，战斗外还能种灵草、做工具、盖房子
hooks.excerpt: The game consists of two main parts: survival mode (offering simple, ordinary, difficult levels as well as hellish challenges) and farming mode (allowing players to cultivate crops including spiritual grasses), craft tools and build houses; continuous updates aim to enhance these aspects further.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 以《西游记》人物为底，混入洪荒修仙世界观做荒诞再创作
hooks.excerpt: The storyline draws inspiration from the four classic novels "Journey to the West" and incorporates traditional Honghuang Xixian world views.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
